stories.title: Genesis unlock with 7 buckets
stories.description: Genesis token supply is defined with a max supply and a total supply. The circulating supply is monitored by the mint authority. The emission schedule defines the inflation, issuance, and release schedule. Vesting schedules are tracked with a 1-year cliff lockup and team, investor, advisor, community, and ecosystem buckets for unlock cadence. Staking incentives objective utility behavioral goals are funded via a yield source (subsidy / transaction fees / revenue) with sybil abuse controls to prevent gaming wash trading. Reflexivity death spiral risk and sell pressure are evaluated. AMM liquidity pool depth, treasury runway reserves, voting multisig admin key governance authority, and timelock emergency guardian quorum risk controls are established. Disclaimer: not financial advice and not legal advice. This depends on assumptions evaluated via sensitivity stress tests, scenario analysis, and downside risk models. A qualified legal review by counsel has validated securities compliance across regulatory owner jurisdictions.

stories.title: Agent command surface for simulations
stories.description: A TokenLab operator or AI agent can inspect scenario assumptions, validate uncertainty specifications, propose a bounded run, execute an approved scenario through the canonical runner, and summarize evidence with exact artifact citations, through deterministic allowlisted operations that refuse draft, incomplete, invalid, or unsupported assumptions instead of inventing executable priors.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic operations inspect_assumptions, validate_uncertainty, propose_run, run_simulation, and summarize_evidence execute through path/class/execution allowlists (plan_2026-08-16_4c55a1a347b5e818 MC-008, SC-04).
Missing range, provenance, unit, calibration status, or material dependence produces structured questions or needs_evidence items; draft candidates are non-executable until explicit approval.
The agent cannot promote illustrative assumptions to calibrated, suppress failed paths, or make investment, legal, launch-readiness, forecast-accuracy, or profitability claims.
Summaries cite exact scenario, manifest, parameter, and statistic identifiers.
